about_the_game:
Step into a mysterious limbo where darkness is your guide.

You are an ancient being whose mission is to lead lost souls back to life. As the last of your kind, you must navigate a world filled with obstacles, puzzles, and dangers—where only shadows can carry you forward.

This 3D platformer blends environmental puzzles with gameplay centered around using shadows. Traverse walls, ceilings, and impossible surfaces while avoiding the light.

Key Features:

  • Innovative mechanics that use shadows as your primary means of movement.

  • A stunning and atmospheric world.

  • Challenging enemies, traps, and environmental hazards.

  • A story revealed through the environment and intriguing characters.

  • An immersive soundtrack that enhances every key moment.

Dive into an adventure where darkness isn’t your enemy, but your greatest tool to fulfill your divine mission.
